description:
2020 was an extremely productive year for the multi-faceted artist Feiertag. He released two EPs and several singles. In June his long-awaited debut album will finally see the light of day on Sonar Kollektiv. An amuse-gueule will now bridge the time until the release date.

«Yearn» is a soulful pop track and the first single off the new album with Oli Hannaford from London and Tessa Rose Jackson from Amsterdam duetting. The two complete each other so well that their voices entangle like lovers and almost can’t let go of each other anymore. Majestic vocals combine with lush percussive elements and smooth drums, whilst rich chords work atop of resonant strings to reveal yet another stunning production from the Dutch artist.

A song for eternity!

What can already be said: «Yearn» is scaling up the expectations for Feiertag’s debut to the max...
